description: baseline (pristine karpathy/autoresearch train.py, unmodified)
Attention throughput: halve the SSSL short-attention span (seq/2=1024 -> seq/4=512). Compute-bound single-epoch regime, so cheaper attention should buy more optimizer steps in the fixed 300s.
Optimizer cadence: halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2**19 -> 2**18, doubling optimizer steps per token at fixed token throughput.
Stack the two confirmed levers from the other lineage: on top of TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2**18, halve the SSSL short-attention span seq/2 -> seq/4.

Push the winning axis: halve the optimizer batch again, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2**18 -> 2**17, with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128 -> 64 to keep grad_accum_steps at 1 (the assert requires TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE %% tokens_
Continue the attention-span axis: short-attention span seq/4=512 -> seq/8=256. Tests whether span reduction has saturated.

Compute-optimal shape: DEPTH 8 -> 6. The run sees ~564M tokens at 50.3M params = 11 tokens/param, well under the ~20 that is compute-optimal at fixed FLOPs, so the model looks over-parameterised for t
Pure throughput, no model change: compile with mode=max-autotune-no-cudagraphs. MFU has drifted down to ~39.8 percent, so better kernel selection should buy steps at zero quality cost.

Bracket the shape axis in the opposite direction: DEPTH 8 -> 10. DEPTH 6 lost badly (+0.043), which falsifies the tokens-per-param argument that predicted a smaller model would win, so capacity appear
Keep climbing the capacity axis: DEPTH 10 -> 12 (model_dim 640 -> 768, n_head 5 -> 6). DEPTH 10 won by 0.0042 with 71 percent more params and 40 percent fewer steps, and MFU rose 40.8 -> 45.0 because

Schedule shape: WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5 -> 0.35. Half the budget spent decaying the LR is a lot, and it matters more now that the run is only 1325 steps rather than 2204.
Embedding LR probe: EMBEDDING_LR 0.6 -> 0.8. With far fewer optimizer steps than baseline, embeddings get less total movement, so a higher rate may compensate.

Push the embedding-LR axis: 0.8 -> 1.0. Raising 0.6 -> 0.8 won 0.0018 (~12 sigma), the clearest knob result of the campaign, so the axis is live and worth bracketing before assuming 0.8 is the optimum
Attention expressivity at constant FLOPs: HEAD_DIM 128 -> 64 doubles the head count at the same model_dim. Same parameter count, same matmul cost, more independent attention subspaces.
Attention span seq/8 -> seq/4. The span was tuned at the old 50.3M shape, and seq/8 was never established over seq/4 (1 sigma).
MATRIX_LR 0.04 -> 0.03. Raising to 0.05 lost 0.0011 (~7 sigma), so if the optimum moved it moved down.
Width sweep at fixed DEPTH 10, wider: model_dim 640 -> 768 (6 heads). Separates width from depth, which the DEPTH knob confounds via rounding.
Width sweep at fixed DEPTH 10, narrower: model_dim 640 -> 512 (4 heads). With the 768 probe this gives three points at constant depth.
UNEMBEDDING_LR 0.004 -> 0.006. The embedding LR responded strongly to being raised; the unembedding is the paired Adam group and may too.

Continue the unembedding-LR axis: 0.006 -> 0.008. Raising 0.004 -> 0.006 won 0.0011 (~7 sigma), so the axis is live and needs bracketing above before it can be closed. Both Adam-group LRs have now pai
Attention span seq/8 -> seq/16 (128 tokens). seq/8 beat seq/4 by ~11 sigma at this shape, so the axis is still live and needs bracketing from below.
WARMUP_RATIO 0.0 -> 0.05. No warmup at all is unusual; at a larger model and higher embedding LR a short warmup may stabilise early steps.
Fine-grained embedding LR probe at 0.9.

SCALAR_LR 0.5 -> 0.7. Same reasoning as the embedding LR: fewer total steps means each Adam group gets less total movement.
WEIGHT_DECAY 0.2 -> 0.1. The run is sub-single-epoch so there is little to regularise against; less decay may leave more capacity usable.
FINAL_LR_FRAC 0.0 -> 0.1. Decaying fully to zero wastes the last steps; a nonzero floor keeps them useful.
WINDOW_PATTERN SSSL -> SSSSSSSL: only 1 layer in 8 attends to full context instead of 2 in 4.
Fine-grained embedding LR probe at 0.9.
WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5 -> 0.7 (MORE cooldown). Corrects a premature closure: I tested only 0.35, saw it lose, and declared 0.5 optimal from a one-sided test. The untested direction is up.
UNEMBEDDING_LR 0.004 -> 0.008. Same family as the embedding LR, which was the campaign's clearest knob win.
RoPE base frequency 10000 -> 50000. A longer rotary wavelength changes how positions are encoded across the 2048-token context; untouched so far and structurally independent of every axis tested.

x0_lambda init 0.1 -> 0.05. These per-layer scalars gate how much of the embedding output is re-injected at each block; the init sets where that mixing starts.
WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1 -> 0.05. 0.2 -> 0.1 won, so bracket below before closing the axis.

EMBEDDING_LR fine probe at 0.85, between the 0.8 and 0.9 results.
MATRIX_LR 0.04 -> 0.035. Both 0.03 and 0.05 failed to beat 0.04; this probes finer.
Muon momentum warmup stretched from 300 to 500 steps. The schedule was set for a ~1000-step run; this one does ~1310.
Muon momentum warmup shortened to 150 steps, bracketing the schedule downward.
RoPE base 50000 -> 25000, refining between the winning 50000 and the baseline 10000.
RoPE base 50000 -> 75000, refining between the winning 50000 and the losing 100000.
FINAL_LR_FRAC 0.05 -> 0.025. 0.05 beat both 0.0 and 0.1, so the optimum is inside (0, 0.1).
DEPTH 10 -> 9. ASPECT_RATIO rounding keeps model_dim at 640, so this is a pure depth change at constant width - the one interior point the earlier sweep skipped.
Value embeddings on every layer instead of alternating. Doubles VE coverage; the ResFormer value-residual path has never been varied.
MLP activation relu-squared -> gelu. The activation has been fixed since the baseline and is untested.
Rotary table length 10x sequence_len -> 4x. Pairs with the RoPE base-frequency win; the table extent is a separate untested knob.
FINAL_LR_FRAC 0.05 -> 0.075, bracketing the winner from above.
EMBEDDING_LR 0.9 -> 0.95, refining between the winning 0.9 and the losing 1.0.
ADAM_BETAS beta2 0.95 -> 0.99. Only beta1 has been probed; beta2 is untouched.
Muon momentum range 0.85->0.95 raised to 0.90->0.98. The endpoints are untested; only the warmup length has been probed.
Muon momentum range lowered to 0.80->0.92, bracketing the endpoints downward.
WEIGHT_DECAY 0.15 -> 0.2 on the current lineage. Reverting to 0.1 lost 0.0019 here, which conflicts with the earlier flat reading; this probes the other side.
MLP expansion 4x -> 3x. Cuts MLP FLOPs ~25%, trading capacity for steps - the capacity/throughput tradeoff at a different lever than DEPTH.
MLP expansion 4x -> 5x, bracketing the ratio upward since DEPTH showed capacity pays here.
MLP expansion 4x -> 3x. Cuts MLP FLOPs ~25%, trading capacity for steps - the capacity/throughput tradeoff at a different lever than DEPTH.
Remove QK normalisation before attention. A load-bearing primitive like the relu-squared activation, never varied; worth knowing whether it earns its cost.
MLP activation relu-squared -> relu-cubed. GeLU lost 0.0254, so the squaring is doing real work; this probes whether the exponent itself is tuned.
DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128 -> 64 at unchanged TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE, so grad_accum_steps goes 1 -> 2. Same optimizer batch, different micro-batching: a pure throughput/memory probe.
float32 matmul precision high -> highest. Trades throughput for numerical precision in the fp32 paths; untested.
